description:
One authored outgoing invoice with its lines (CompanyMember read).

Carries the header (customer, dates, currency, discounts), every line with its
computed ``net_amount``/``vat_amount``/``gross_amount``, the document totals, and
the lifecycle: ``status`` (``draft`` → ``issued`` → ``cancelled``), ``document_no``
(assigned at issue — ``null`` on a draft), ``commercial_document_id`` /
``snapshot_document_id`` (the booked document and the frozen PDF), plus the derived
``payment_status`` and ``open_amount`` read from the linked open item.

This is the **authored** arm only. A receivable that arrived as an ingested
document is an ``item``, not an ``ar_invoice``; the two arms are listed together by
``GET …/ar/receivables``. Use ``GET …/ar/invoices/{invoice_id}/related`` for the
journal entry, the settling bank transactions and the credit-note chain.
name: get_ar_invoice
